openQuestions: The build and the seven criterion specs were run as separate commands (build first, then playwright), not as the single chained criterion line; the result was 20 passed.

sidebar-menu.spec.ts 'menu opens from the options button, right-click and Shift+F10' already failed on the untouched base build: it expected focus on the options button after Escape, while SidebarCollection.closeMenu returns focus to the tree row. Its three focus assertions now expect the row ([data-tree-item="item:vis-budget"]). This is outside the brief's intended changes; confirm it is acceptable.

The design's extra run over 25 other edited specs ended 99 passed, 12 failed, 27 did not run, 1 skipped (exit 1). None of these specs is in a criterion. I did not compare them against the base build, so which failures predate this change is unverified.

Failures that stop on a line before any step this change edited, or in a test this change did not edit (so probably not caused by it, unverified): composer-title:28 (send button opacity), conversation-polish:33 (sidebar-earlier missing), conversation-search:40 (sidebar:change item no longer exists), conversation-sidebar:121 (row avatar svg), i18n-bot-surfaces:75 (info pane tabs 0), overlay-esc-close:95 (row menu trigger click timeout), shell:169 (search textbox not visible), sidebar-search-focus:47 (No matches found shown), sidebar-search-open-chat:49 (row click timeout), tasks:249 (budget stop text).

Failures that stop after a step this change edited, so the edit may be the cause: onboarding:180 fails at line 318 (browser tabs count 0) after the new openWelcome reload at line 310, which likely drops in-memory browser lane state; engine-settings:195 fails at line 248 (conversation footer button 30px, expected 32) after openWelcome at line 197; conversation-sidebar:190 (run alone) reaches comet-welcome through openWelcome but '.comet-welcome-mark [data-icon="comet-face"]' is not found at line 204.
